reference.title: HTML5 Tag Manager view
reference.shortdesc: There is added support for the HTML5 Tag Manager view featuring an intuitive design that enables a more efficient overall tagging workflow.

fig.title: HTML5 Tag Manager view in a browser

section.p: It provides the same functionality as the Edit Tags window in WB, but with some additional workflow enhancements. For example, the “context sensitive tagging” feature (as shown in the above image), is also available in the existing Edit Tags window via the dropdown list with either the Show All, Best Only or Valid Only option; and provides advanced tag filtering as well.
The following enhancements in the HTML5 Tag Manager result in a more efficient tagging workflow:

li.p: Allows bulk tagging of components via the browser
Seamlessly view direct and implied tags
Export all direct and implied component tags for templating and ongoing management
Integrates with the Search Service to improve workflow
Added as a default view on all station components for enhanced flexibility

section.p: The manager view functions identically whether accessed from within WB or a browser.
